status: declared by the pull request that closes #639 before any score; step 1 of H9, an exploratory screen on development data, not a record and not a verdict (scoring protocol v1 section 1; ruling on #639, 12 October 2026). Nothing is fitted, selected into a model or published, no rule, threshold, onset definition or availability time changes, no day after 2025-12-31 is read, and no hindsight regime label is used (ruling on #515). None of the intervals is corrected for multiplicity

panel.built_by: scripts/richer_targets_639.py panel over measurement_fields.py's scratch panel and early_warning_inputs.py's

days: the scored days of the lead-1 fold grid, 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31 (source_screen), the same days at every lead

targets.definition: ON RRP take-up, the day's total accepted
ON RRP take-up, change from the previous panel day
standing repo facility take-up, the day's total accepted

target_reading: the realised value of the scored day, as the panel holds it; the forecasts' inputs are read as of each decision instant through repo_model.asof.InformationRule at the declared leads

benchmarks.B1: the last public value plus the empirical distribution of the lead's own changes over the trailing two years (protocol v1 section 4, generalised to the series)
benchmarks.B2: the trailing year's values on days of the scored day's reporting day type (protocol v1 section 4, generalised)
benchmarks.dropped: a day on which the outcome, B1 or B2 is missing is dropped for both benchmarks

scores.crps: scoring_protocol.grid_crps on the protocol's 23 quantile levels
scores.mae: the absolute error of the forecast's median (level 0.5)
scores.naive: the absolute error of the last public value
scores.skill: mean(S(B2) - S(B1)) / mean(S(B2)): positive when B1 beats B2

interval.paired_crps: scoring_protocol.paired_test, stationary bootstrap, mean block 10, 10000 draws, seed 639, one-sided 95% lower bound of mean(d) and a two-sided 90% interval of skill
interval.correlations: stationary bootstrap of full-sample ranks, mean block 10, 1000 draws, seed 639, two-sided 90%

splits.regime: the as-of scarcity state at the same lead: ample (0, 1), scarce (2, 3)

outcomes: pressure: the spread strictly above +5 bp on whole basis points (repo_model.data.exceeds_bp)
lead.pressure_is_not_a_judge: the +5 bp indicator is the definition of an episode here, as in the screens of #478 and #629; the judge it served is retired as a decision rule (protocol v1 section 10)
lead.onsets: repo_model.pressure.onsets at +5 bp over the scored days of the grid every horizon scores (from 2018-07-06)

overlap: Spearman of the target with SOFR - IORB on the same day, in level and in the change from the previous panel day
not_run: step 2, the model: its targets are chosen from this screen, which is Eleonora's call (see the pull request)
